mapper.sql: run_id, scheduler_version, plan_generation, defer_reason, next_visible_at, coordination_served_round, coordination_missed_rounds, dispatch_served_round, dispatch_missed_rounds, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run_coordination (run_id, scheduler_version, plan_generation) VALUES (#{runId}, #{schedulerVersion}, #{planGeneration}) ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_coordination SET defer_reason = #{deferReason}, next_visible_at = #{nextVisibleAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_coordination SET defer_reason = NULL, next_visible_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, coordination_served_round = #{roundNumber}, coordination_missed_rounds = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId}
UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_coordination SET dispatch_served_round = #{roundNumber}, dispatch_missed_rounds = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId}
UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run_coordination SET plan_generation = #{planGeneration}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.run_id, c.scheduler_version, c.plan_generation, c.defer_reason, c.next_visible_at, c.coordination_served_round, c.coordination_missed_rounds, c.dispatch_served_round, c.dispatch_missed_rounds, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM alphafrog_agent_run_coordination c JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = c.run_id WHERE c.scheduler_version = #{schedulerVersion} AND c.next_visible_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND r.status IN ('RECEIVED', 'PLANNING', 'EXECUTING', 'WAITING', 'SUMMARIZING', 'WAITING_TOOL_JOB') ORDER BY c.coordination_served_round, c.next_visible_at, c.run_id LIMIT #{limit}
